items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: No, nothing special, but he was a nice trumpet player and I liked to start playing.

ctx.x: I guess he did. Well, I'll tell you what, me at that time, I wasn't good enough. Maybe I might have done the same thing, but I couldn't play instrument good enough. You got started. Yeah, you got started.
You mentioned Bart Johnson before. Do you remember anything special about him?
No, nothing special, but he was a nice trumpet player and I liked to start playing. You heard him play? Oh, yeah. Before you started playing? Yeah, before I started playing.
